extracted.intended_audience: researchers, institutions, or clients seeking professional science press-release writing, editing, and EurekAlert (AAAS) submission services
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service rules for ordering, writing/editing, and submitting science press releases (including AAAS EurekAlert filing) from a commercial provider. Covers payment, timing, package deliverables, pricing, and quality/translation standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepayment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release services must be prepaid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order form selection and specification
rubrics_metrics.description: In the order form, select “Writing/consulting” in the drop-down primary service menu, and specify your desired package in the open note to WSR field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended lead time and approval delay
rubrics_metrics.description: It would be prudent to submit your press release order a week before the intended release date to ensure sufficient time for any follow-up edits or clarifications and to account for the AAAS approval delay (1-2 business days).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit ~1 week ahead to allow for edits/clarifications and the stated 1-2 business day AAAS approval delay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing + submission package — purpose and deliverables
rubrics_metrics.description: Editing of text to ensure it reads well and is maximally impactful. Client confirmation of edited text; application of post-edit requests. Filling EurekAlert form via our Public Information Officer (PIO) account. Submission and posting for requested date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Price listed: Editing + submission $550. Cost includes $375 EurekAlert filing fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing 10-pack — pricing and usage terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Editing + submission 10-pack $4900. Additional press releases within 12-month period discounted to $450 each. Multiple clients are welcome to share PR packs. Funds remaining can be applied to future orders with WSR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bulk-purchase discount applies within 12 months; packs are shareable and remaining funds are usable for future orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing + submission package — variants and deliverables
rubrics_metrics.description: Text written de novo based on main points specified for emphasis by the client. Client confirmation of written text; any additional post-edit requests will be applied. Filling EurekAlert via our PIO account. Submission and posting for requested date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two price variants: From document edited and/or translated by WSR $660; For content not handled previously by WSR $715. Cost includes $375 EurekAlert filing fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing 10-pack — pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Writing + submission 10-pack: From documents edited and/or translated by WSR $5940; For content not handled previously by WSR $6435.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bulk pricing tiers differ depending on whether WSR previously edited/translated the source documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Client confirmation and post-edit policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Client confirmation of edited/written text is required; any additional post-edit requests will be applied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WSR implements client-confirmed changes and will apply post-edit requests after initial editing/writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission via PIO account and scheduling
rubrics_metrics.description: Filling EurekAlert form via our Public Information Officer (PIO) account. Submission and posting for requested date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WSR handles the EurekAlert form submission through its PIO account and aims to post on the client's requested date (subject to AAAS approval timing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Service level and turnaround selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose your level of service and turnaround time: Standard, Premium, or Superior Service; Regular or Rush Turnaround.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clients select both a service quality level and a turnaround speed; specific details presumably available on linked pages (Turnaround Time / Service Levels).

rubrics_metrics.name: Editor qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Editors with completed PhDs with expertise across a broad spectrum of fields (e.g., Astronomy/Cosmology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Chemistry, Computing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff qualifications are presented as a quality credential for editing and translation work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-step translation process for non-English source texts
rubrics_metrics.description: Unique two-step translation process: First, your paper will be translated into English by a scientist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied quality claim that scientist-led translation improves accuracy of scientific translation; further steps (e.g., editing) implied by 'two-step' but not fully detailed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing fee inclusion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specified for both editing+submission and writing+submission packages.
